title: Extract WNBA ml_training/ to shared services/ml/
description: If the build_training_dataset / train_model / validate_model / upload_to_s3 modules in app/services/etl/wnba/ml_training/ end up being reused for other sports or other prop types, refactor into app/services/ml/ as shared tooling. Initially they live alongside the WNBA ETL to keep Plan B self-contained.

title: Evaluate league-discriminator schema unification
description: Parallel pred_wnba_* tables added per Plan A. If maintenance cost across NBA+WNBA tables becomes painful, evaluate migrating to a unified schema with a league discriminator column.

title: WNBA Phase 3 — additional player props (blocks/steals/3PM/FTM/PRA)
description: After Phase 2 (points/assists/rebounds) ships and stabilizes, evaluate adding the remaining 5 NBA-parity props for WNBA. Requires new schema tables (pred_wnba_blocks_projections etc), new models, and likely lower priority since these props have thinner WNBA market liquidity.

title: Upgrade WNBA spread projector from Elo+pace to ML
description: Plan A ships an Elo+pace overlay spread projector. After Phase 2 we will have player-availability features (today_active_players + injury-adjusted minutes). At that point an ML spread model with player-level inputs could beat Elo materially. Re-evaluate after Phase 2 lands.

title: Fix duplicate-row bug in WNBA ETL merge() pattern
description: Five WNBA ETLs use db.merge(Obj(...)) without setting the primary key id, which always INSERTs rather than upserts. Affected: update_team_roster, update_team_offense_stats, update_team_defense_stats, update_injury_status, today_active_players. Tables with unique constraints (offense/defense_stats, injury_status, today_active_players) now hard-fail on second run; team_roster silently duplicates rows. Discovered during Phase 2 T14 smoke 2026-05-22. Convert all five to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (Postgres native upsert) and add a UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) constraint to pred_wnba_team_roster. Manual dedupe SQL applied to recover team_roster on 2026-05-22.
close_reason: Converted five WNBA ETLs to Postgres ON CONFLICT upserts; added UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) on pred_wnba_team_roster

title: Evaluate per-book market line storage for WNBA
description: WNBA Plan A stores consensus avg only in pred_wnba_game_lines. If/when UI grows a best-line feature, revisit to store per-book rows like pred_nba_game_lines does.

title: WNBA Phase 2 — player prop models (points/assists/rebounds)
description: Plan B to be written after Plan A ships. Train XGBoost models on 2021-2025 history with hard MAE thresholds (Points <= 4.5, Assists <= 1.5, Rebounds <= 2.0). Schema tables already created in Plan A migration. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-21-wnba-support-design.md.
close_reason: Phase 2 props live: MAE gates passed, ETL+Celery wired, 67 WNBA tests green, API route returns points/assists/rebounds

title: NBA spread/win-prob projector (backport from WNBA)
description: After WNBA Plan A ships, port the WNBA Elo+pace spread/win-prob projector to NBA. NBA currently has only a totals_projector and no own spread/win-prob model. Lives in app/services/etl/nba/spread_projector.py mirroring the WNBA file.
